# Ukti

> Ukti is a styling app that issues one outfit a day, built from the clothes you
> already own. You add your closet; each morning Ukti picks a single look and
> tells you why it works. There is no feed, no options carousel, and no ads —
> one verdict, and a new one tomorrow.

Ukti is available on iOS and Android. It is a product of Slickalgo Analytics LLP,
made in Bangalore, established 2026.

## What it does

- **One outfit a day.** A single daily verdict styled from your own wardrobe, with
  the reasoning behind it. It is replaced the next morning — there is no archive
  of options to scroll.
- **Your closet.** Photograph your clothes; Ukti styles from what is actually in
  your wardrobe rather than from a catalogue.
- **Your Look, read weekly.** A periodic reading of how you present, with a plan.
- **Your skin, read weekly.** A skin analysis from a selfie, with a routine.
- **A stylist that listens.** Talk to Ukti by voice or in writing to shape what it
  knows about you.
- **Shopping as curation.** Where Ukti suggests something you do not own, it links
  out to retailers. Nothing is bought inside the app.

## What it deliberately does not do

- No social feed, no sharing, no follower counts, no trending.
- No in-app purchasing of clothing — shopping links go out to retailers.
- No infinite options: one outfit per day is the whole product.
- No ads.

## Access

Ukti has a free tier and a paid membership. Pricing varies by country and store;
the current price is shown in the app at purchase. Ukti is rated 18+.
